# MaxLinear, Inc. Announces Upcoming Financial Conference Participation


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_7d9a45046dcb5c6688625a9b8d2e71bd/maxlinear/news/2026-05-28_MaxLinear_Inc_Announces_Upcoming_Financial_614.pdf) May 28, 2026


CARLSBAD, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- MaxLinear, Inc. (Nasdaq: MXL), a leading provider of radio frequency (RF), analog, digital and mixed-signal integrated circuits, today announced that it will participate in the following upcoming financial conferences:


- Stifel 2026 Boston Cross Sector 1x1 Conference in Boston on June 3rd
- Northland Virtual Growth Conference on June 23rd


**About MaxLinear, Inc.**


MaxLinear, Inc. (Nasdaq:MXL) is a leading provider of radio frequency (RF), analog, digital and mixed-signal integrated circuits for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi-market applications. MaxLinear is headquartered in Carlsbad, California. For more information, please visit[www.maxlinear.com](http://www.maxlinear.com/) .


MXL is MaxLinear’s registered trademark. Other trademarks appearing herein are the property of their respective owners.
